title: How to Edit the Reviews Form | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Edit the Reviews Form Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000080093 Edit the Reviews Form: Navigate to Toolbox - Form Manager look for the form: Listing - Write Review Hover over 'Actions' and click on Customize: The Title and Review fields can be edited inside the Reviews Form. Bear in mind that the option to make the Title field required will not display, due that this field will always be required. The email address is a mandatory field. Even though the form has the option to turn off the required field, the reviews feature is coded to require this field always. Additional Information: » Toolbox » Form Manager Folder Edit the Rating Criteria The Reviews form also includes a list of criteria to rate the member: The rating criteria can be edited through the text labels. Go to: Settings > Text Labels > search for "rating criteria": IMPORTANT : If one of the 6 labels is left blank, it will not appear on the form: For more infomration please refer to the following articles: » How to locate Text Labels on the Front End of The Website » Settings » Text Labels For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
